DEWALT DCS334N-XJ 18V XR cordless jigsaw features an efficient brushless motor for improved power, runtime and performance. The all-metal gearbox and aluminium base provide durability, whilst the compact top handle, variable speed trigger, lock-off switch, and speed control wheel offer maximum control and safety. Includes 4-position pendulum action for fast, accurate cuts in various materials, a support bevel for cuts up to 47° and twin LED lights. Tool-free blade change system ensures secure blade holding and consistent square cuts, and a dust blower to keep the cutting line clear. An ergonomic soft-grip handle ensures comfort. Offers precise, high-performance cutting, ideal for professional use. Compatible with all Dewalt 18V XR Li-Ion batteries and chargers (sold separately).
